fact: Following a Government decision of 16 March 2020, the District Council of Moka was mandated by the Ministry of Local Government and Disaster Risk Management to implement the I-Council in all local authorities, the project being steered by the Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation.
title: e-Newsletter Issue 1 - December 2020: The I-Council Project of Moka District Council
publisher: Ministry of Public Service, Administrative and Institutional Reforms
